definitions.explanation: Thick, sweetened concentrated milk in a tube or can. In Japan the term almost always refers to the sweetened version; unsweetened concentrated milk is called {無糖|むとう}{練乳|れんにゅう} or エバミルク.

examples.japanese: イチゴ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧コンデンスミルク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: To pour condensed milk over strawberries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{紅茶|こうちゃ}→紅茶：02878_koucha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧コンデンスミルク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put condensed milk in the iced tea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧、⟦かき{氷|ごおり}→かき氷：10300_kakigoori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧コンデンスミルク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{食|た}べていた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: My mother always used to put condensed milk on shaved ice.

notes:
Loanword from English "condensed milk." In Japanese culinary usage the native term ⟦{練乳|れんにゅう}→練乳：21061_rennyuu⟧ is at least as common, and many home recipes alternate between the two. Both nearly always mean the sweetened type.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コンデンスミルク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to pour condensed milk on (something)
- コンデンスミルク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put condensed milk in (a drink)
- ⟦{練乳|れんにゅう}→練乳：21061_rennyuu⟧{入|い}り: containing condensed milk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{練乳|れんにゅう}→練乳：21061_rennyuu⟧: condensed milk — native term; same product, slightly more old-fashioned/everyday
- エバミルク: evaporated milk — unsweetened concentrated milk
- ⟦{生|なま}クリーム→生クリーム：15884_namakuriimu⟧: heavy cream — fresh dairy cream, not sweetened or concentrated
